method: All 55 reports flagged by the langid and script screen (data/frozen/made/language_screen.json, written by scripts/prepare_made.py) were read by an LLM on 2026-09-26. The flags were citations and author lists, institutional affiliations, product and lot codes, and short English descriptions that langid misclassified. No report contains non-English text, so no report is excluded.
